entries.title: Greenbrier Valley Election 2024 community roundtable: Help write our Citizens Agenda
entries.summary: Join reporters from Mountain State Spotlight for a guided roundtable discussion about what's most important for you this election season.
entries.content:
Election season is underway, and that means candidates will be out vying for your vote.

We want you to help guide Mountain State Spotlight’s election coverage.

What do you want the candidates to be discussing as they ask for your vote? We want to hear from you!

Join reporters and editors from Mountain State Spotlight and other community members for a guided roundtable discussion about what’s most important for you this election season.

What: Guided community roundtable discussion around the election

When: Thursday September 12, 5:30 – 7:30 p.m.

Where: 625 Edgar Ave, Ronceverte, WV 24970

About Mountain State Spotlight: Mountain State Spotlight is an independent, reader-supported newsroom covering West Virginia.

Refreshments will be provided.

Funding for this event provided by the Jonathan Logan Family Foundation.
entries.author: Mountain State Spotlight Staff
